tha-ap440:1.2: ambajambuvibhītakaṁ → ambajambuvibhedakaṁ (sya-all); ambajambuvibhīṭakaṁ (pts) | amba-jambu-vibhīṭakaṁ → G. S1 -vibhedakaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap440:1.3: billaṁ sayameva harāmahaṁ → bellaṁ sayamevāharāmahaṁ (sya-all) | kolaṁ → S1 S2 kolā. (pts note)
tha-ap440:2.3: āpīḷentaṁ adutīyaṁ → papīḷentaṁ adutiyaṁ (bj, pts); āpīḷitaṁ addhaniyaṁ (sya-all) | papīḷentaṁ → āpīḷentaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | papīḷentaṁ → G. papīḷantaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap440:3.3: khādamattamhi → katamattamhi (bj) | khādamattamhi bhesajje → katamattamhi bhesajjaṁ (sya-all) | katamattamhi → khādamattamhi (bj: machasaṁ) | khādamattamhi → S1 S2 katamattaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap440:3.4: byādhi passambhi → vyādhi passamhi (bj) | passambhi → passaddhi (cck: ka.) | passambhi → S1 S2 vyadhi passamhi; G. -passammi. (pts note)
tha-ap440:4.2: anumodamakāsi me → anumodaniyaṁ akā (bj, sya-all) | akā → anumodamakāsi me (bj: machasaṁ) | akā → G. S1 anumodam akāsi me. (pts note)
tha-ap440:5.3: hotu → hohi (bj, sya-all, pts) | hohi → hotu (bj: machasaṁ) | hohi → G. S1 hoti. (pts note)
tha-ap440:5.4: byādhimāgamā → vyādhi āgamā (bj, pts) | āgamā → byādhimāgamā (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap440:6.3: abbhuggamī → abbhuggami (bj, sya-all) | dhīro haṁsarājāva → vīro haṁsarājā va (pts) | abbhuggamī → G. abbhuggami. (pts note) | vīro → G. dhīro. (pts note)
tha-ap440:7.1: harītakaṁ dinnaṁ → harīṭakamadaṁ (bj, pts); harītakimadaṁ (sya-all) | harīṭakamadaṁ → harītakaṁ dinnaṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap440:8.3: sacchikatā → anuppattā (sya-all) | sacchikatā → G. anuppattā. (pts note)
